svg.title: Figure 1 · The 3D scenes
svg.desc: Every 3D scene and variant with what it replays
svg.text: 6 scenes and 2 look variants: the hazards each shows, the simulation it replays and its outcome, and the look it is drawn in. A variant changes only the look; the analysis
is the base scene's. Pages pin three.js 0.170.0.
Slow supply leak on a slope; balance lost before the hold engages
Protective stop removes leg force instead of crouching
Frozen posture feedback with no staleness monitor
Burst supply loss with failed load holding; the cockpit drops
Link loss with return-to-launch; the UAV descends into the pilot …
Link loss after the walker moved; the UAV lands at the stale home

Generated by tools/figures/scenes3d_readme.py from scenes.yaml, the library and the exported scene analysis. The scenes replay synthetic results: a picture of a simulation, not evidence (sim/README.md, evidence gate).

g.text: Terms: 3D = three-dimensional · EC-nnn = edge case found by a failure search · FLT-nnn = walker fault in sim/faults.yaml · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the

open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · S3-nnn = 3D hazard scene (sim/scenes3d) · SF-nnn = walker failure-search family (sim/search) · SITL = software-in-the-loop simulation · SU-nnn = UAV PX4
SITL scenario · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
